changes: Do not treat 0.1.31-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: AED still does not follow FUNC+T1-T8. 0.1.31 jsr'd 0x40078850(1) and 0x4002f2f8 without copying the track's sample record. 0.1.32 jsr's stock 0x4006de34 with that record, refreshes the current page (0x400554e0 / 0x4004d640) and then redraws AED. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Documentation (same version): qualification record, static ColdFire size/cycle estimate, and hardware LCD photographs of SYSTEM STATUS TM 0.1.32 plus PERSONALIZE TRACK MUTES empty and ticked. AED follow of FUNC+T is still unverified.

Do not treat 0.1.30-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: with AED (waveform editor) open, FUNC+T1-T8 select does not show that track's waveform. 0.1.31 jsr's stock 0x40078850 (rebind sample), 0x4002f2f8 (AED redraw) and 0x4007b780 after FUNC+T select. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.29-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: with T8 in MASTER mode, FUNC+T focus hangs on the MASTER TRACK title and that overlay supersedes SRC/AMP/LFO/FX1/FX2 (stock draws MASTER TRACK on SRC only). 0.1.29 opened 0x400791e4 on every second FUNC+T and re-ran TRACK_PAGES on hold. 0.1.30 selects on press only, restores a double-tap window, and does not create that overlay for T8 in MASTER mode. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.28-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: FUNC+double-tap T never opened the sample list; MIDI button dark / no MIDI page; T8 in MASTER mode still unmuteable from T8 and QUICK MUTE trig 8. 0.1.28 jmp'd 0x40083ab4 (MIDI dispatcher / 0x40044920). 0.1.29 jsr's 0x400791e4 after the track is selected, eor's T1-T8 mute bits without stock MASTER coupling (0x4007c428), and QUICK MUTE audio trigs 1-8 skip that helper. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.27-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: TRACK 8 (MASTER) mute/unmute unresponsive from T and QUICK MUTE; FUNC+double-tap T opened the sample list twice then stopped. 0.1.27 jsr'd 0x40083ab4 with extra stack args; that routine also jmp's 0x40044920, which unbalances the stack. 0.1.28 jmp's 0x40083ab4 with the original (key, event) slots and keeps the double-tap last-key/timer in module BSS. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.26-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: mute, QUICK MUTE and FUNC+REC1/2 on MIDI TRACKS recovered, but stock double-tap T1-T8 no longer opens the sample slot list (T mutes). 0.1.27: FUNC+double-tap T1-T8 uses the stock last-key and UI timer, then jsr's 0x40083ab4(key, event 3) so audio tracks can browse and assign a sample. MIDI tracks still skip that list. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.25-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: FUNC+REC1/REC2 still do not open recorder-buffer submenus on the MIDI TRACKS page. Stock jsr's 0x40033970 there (returns MIDI_MODE) and skips creating the overlay. 0.1.26 continues that create so FUNC+REC1/2 open from MIDI TRACKS. Removes the 0.1.25 pickup-toggle hook. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.24-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: mute/unmute less stable than 0.1.23; MIDI REC1/REC2 still inaccessible. 0.1.24 applied mute from T-hold inside the held-key walker. 0.1.25 restores the 0.1.23 UI chord window and 7e998(7)/(0). MIDI mute no longer jsr's 0x40033e3c as MIDI CC 0x70+t. In MIDI mode REC1/REC2 jmp stock recorder setup (0x40030e6c / 0x40030c60) instead of the pickup-flag toggle. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.23-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: QUICK MUTE mute and trig LEDs recovered, but MIDI REC1/REC2 still inaccessible; REC1/REC2/REC3 have no selection LED (stock also leaves those dark). 0.1.18-0.1.23 hooked the UI tick; 0.1.14 recovered REC1/REC2 by leaving that tick stock. 0.1.24 applies T and QUICK MUTE from the key handlers only (press and first hold; release clears held). USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.22-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: QUICK MUTE mute still stable, but trig 1-16 red/green LEDs unresponsive; MIDI REC1/REC2 still inaccessible. 0.1.22 called 7e998(7) then 7e998(1); stock's second call is driver 0. 0.1.23 jsr's 7e998(7) and 7e998(0) only, does not call 0x4004581c from the UI tick, and hooks 0x4005227e so 9b290 and 22c00 run stock, saving d1-d7/a0-a6 around apply. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.21-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: QUICK MUTE chords stable, but trig LEDs 5-8 unresponsive and trigs 9-12 (MIDI) crashed EXCEPTION VEC:03 ADDR:00000102. 0.1.21 jsr'd 0x4007e998 with the trig index 0-15; that table is eight LED drivers, so 8-15 jumped to garbage. 0.1.22 keeps 0x4003d29c per bit, then stock 0x4004581c, 7e998(7) and 7e998(1) only. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.20-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: REC1/REC2 still inaccessible in MIDI mode; QUICK MUTE trigs more responsive but red/green mute LEDs dark. 0.1.20 still ran inside 0x4003fed8 (MIDI UI). 0.1.21 hooks 0x40052242 so 4bd48/3fed8/44804 run stock, then applies chords and keeps 9b290's d0. QUICK MUTE calls stock 0x4003d29c plus 0x4004581c and 0x4007e998 so trig 1-16 mute LEDs follow. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.19-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: REC3 accessible in MIDI mode, REC1/REC2 still unresponsive. 0.1.19 still ran between the held-key walk and 0x4004bd48 (the MIDI/REC UI). 0.1.20 hooks 0x40052232 so 4bd48 runs stock, then applies T chords. QUICK MUTE (trig mode 4) latches trig 1-16 presses into a short UI window and jsr's stock 0x4003d29c, the same pattern that stabilised T1-T8. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.18-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: TRACK mute stable, but REC1/REC2/REC3 inaccessible in MIDI mode. 0.1.18 ran T-hold work inside the held-key walk and left 0x400316a0's d0/a0 unrestored before the rest of the UI tick (0x4004bd48). 0.1.19 latches T presses only, save/restores d0-d7/a0-a6 after that walk, and skips the rearm loop on idle ticks. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

0.1.17 same-unit: almost perfect, occasional missed T in a chord. 0.1.17 only latched T-key press (event 1); the dispatcher often delivers extra keys in a chord as hold (event 2) only. 0.1.18 ORs that hold bit into the same latch (still no mute/LED from the held-key walker) and waits a couple more UI frames before applying the current audio or MIDI page. A press the panel never sends as press or hold, and that never appears in T-row at the UI tick, cannot be recovered without the unsafe UART sample. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.16-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: all tracks muted and unmuted constantly per tick. 0.1.16 OR-accumulated T-row 0x46100b1a from the panel UART flush, which samples that byte mid-scan, so the chord latch filled with every T bit every frame. 0.1.17 never hooks 0x4009228c. It only collects T-row at the UI tick plus the T key that reached 0x40040250, then applies the current audio or MIDI page once. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.15-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: simultaneous T1-T8 mute/unmute still temperamental on audio and MIDI pages. 0.1.15 sampled T-row once per UI tick, so a chord whose keys are not in that snapshot was missed. 0.1.16 OR-accumulates 0x46100b1a on the panel flush 0x4009228c without calling mute/LED from interrupt (the 0.1.11 crash), waits a short UI window, then eor's every collected T bit into the current page's mute word in one write. Audio and MIDI pages stay independent. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.14-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: audio and MIDI mute states were forced identical; they are two pages with their own mutes. Simultaneous T1-T8 still temperamental. 0.1.15 toggles only the current page (MIDI_MODE 0x80000012) through stock 0x4007d6a4 / 0x4007d7b0. It never enters the held-key walker 0x400316a0; the UI tick jsr at 0x40052228 runs that walker then scans T-row 0x46100b1a so late keys in a chord mute. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.13-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: MIDI button still dead, TRACK in MIDI mode not the same as audio, REC1/REC2 menu toggle crashed, unit more unstable. 0.1.12-0.1.13 hooked the held-key dispatcher 0x400316a0 (every held key, including MIDI/REC). 0.1.14 never hooks that site. Only T-alone 0x40040250 and FUNC+T 0x40083dfc. T1-T8 mute both 0x80000008 and 0x8000000c so MIDI tracks follow the same mute as audio. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.12-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: MIDI, REC1 and REC2 unresponsive. 0.1.12 polled from the held-key dispatcher 0x400316a0 without saving the caller's d2/a2-a4, so later keys in that UI tick saw clobbered registers. 0.1.13 saves d0-d7/a0-a6 around the poll. T1-T8 mute now eor's both the audio mute word 0x80000008 and the MIDI mute word 0x8000000c so MIDI tracks mute globally with the same T keys. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.11-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: simultaneous mute still temperamental; T5-T8 together crashed (red LED, tempo hang, host saw the Octatrack over USB). 0.1.11 jsr'd the mute LED from the panel UART flush 0x4009228c (interrupt context). 0.1.12 never hooks that flush. It polls the T1-T8 held row 0x46100b1a from the UI tick 0x400316a0 and from the T handler, and writes the mute word once for the whole chord. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.10-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: simultaneous T1-T8 mute is more reliable but still temperamental. 0.1.10 still waited on the TRACK handler, which the dispatcher does not call for every key in a chord. T1-T8 are one panel UART row (held bitmap 0x46100b1a). 0.1.11 polls that byte on every T event and on the panel flush so all eight bits that are down mute together. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.9-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: simultaneous T1-T8 mute is more reliable than 0.1.8 but still temperamental. 0.1.9 re-armed a T key whenever its down-byte went 0, so a chord that ghosted a record toggled twice; MUTE_APPLY 0x4007c428 also does not store or light the mute LED. 0.1.10 writes the mute word the way stock FUNC+T does (0x4007d7b0's store + 0x40033e3c) and only re-arms on release. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.8-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: simultaneous T1-T8 mute is still unreliable, and TRACK MUTES showed X on boot (one YES did not clear it). The getter treated any leftover word at 0x800000dc as ticked, and YES eor'd a LIVE copy that started at 0, so the first press wrote 1 again. 0.1.9 stores MAGIC_OFF / MAGIC_ON: anything else is an empty box, and one YES ticks or clears. T-alone scans the eight stock T1-T8 down-bytes and mutes every newly down key in one apply, including keys that only arrive as a hold on another T. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.7-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: no change — FUNC+T still does not put the page editor on that track (stuck on T1), and simultaneous T1-T8 mute is still temperamental. FUNC+T is not the T-alone handler 0x40040250; the FUNC-layer keymap sends T1-T8 to 0x40083dfc (stock mute). 0.1.4-0.1.7 never hooked that site. 0.1.8 hooks 0x40083dfc: FUNC+T writes 0x80000000 / 0x100b14cc and jsr's 0x40043728 / 0x40097460 / 0x400326a0 / 0x4004d780 so knobs and pages edit that track. T-alone mute on 0x40040250 now takes the first down (press or hold) and re-arms on release. CUE+T is left to stock. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.6-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: four T keys can mute at once, but unmute is tied to the green focus LED (unmute T8 lights T8; T7 must be unmuted to unfocus T8). FUNC_LATCH made a T press look like FUNC+T (select instead of mute), and hold events re-toggled. 0.1.7 mutes only on a T press, independently of which track is focused, and ignores the FUNC latch. FUNC+T writes 0x80000000 / 0x100b14cc and jsr's 0x40043728 / 0x40097460 / 0x400326a0 / 0x4004d780 so knobs and pages edit that track. CUE+T is left to stock. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.5-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: FUNC+T still only lights the green track LEDs (knobs stay on the previous edit track), two tracks can light at once, and mute chords still stop at two keys. 0.1.5 jmp'd stock 0x40083ab4, which is highlight, not the editor. The mute scan tst.b'd the last byte of each big-endian held long. 0.1.6 FUNC+T writes 0x80000000 / 0x100b14cc and jsr's 0x40097460 / 0x400326a0 / 0x4004d780 so the knobs and pages edit that one track. T-alone mute tst.l's all eight TRACK held longs so T1-T8 can mute together. CUE+T is left to stock. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.4-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: FUNC+T still does not select for editing, mute chords still stop at two T keys, and two pixels are missing from the top border of the main screen only (PROJ is fine). 0.1.4 jsr'd 0x40083bf8 from the TRACK key handler; that helper is not safe there and smashed the main-screen draw. 0.1.5 never calls it. FUNC+T hides FUNC and continues stock 0x40040256 so the T-press select path runs. T-alone mute scans all eight TRACK held bytes and restores d2 so a chord is not limited to two handler events. CUE+T is left to stock. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.3-experimental as a pass. Same-unit: FUNC+T still only lights another track (knobs stay on T1), and T-mute chords stop at two keys. 0.1.3 jsr'd 0x400837f8, a file offset, not runtime 0x40083bf8 (the helper that writes 0x80000000). It also only hooked the type-1 jmp, so extra T presses in a chord never arrived. 0.1.4 hooks the TRACK handler 0x40040250: each T1-T8 press or first hold toggles that track so all eight can mute together; FUNC+T jsr's 0x40083bf8 and writes 0x80000000 / 0x100b14cc so the knobs and pages edit that track. CUE+T is left to stock. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.2-experimental as a pass. Same-unit card of 0.1.2 (ELEK TM 0.1.2, SHA-256 69a8c7de177603fcede63b5653b0c3f8e909ca777386bad9d175cb008c2f35eb): FUNC+T highlights another track but the knobs and pages still edit T1. 0.1.2 wrote 0x80000035 (LEVEL's track) and the highlight shadow. Stock T-press select writes the edit track at 0x80000000 then runs 0x400837f8. 0.1.3 jsr's that helper on FUNC+T so T2-T8 become the edit track. Private card of 0.1.3 prepared (ELEK TM 0.1.3, SHA-256 84c21f21553d8a99432bf4299e821141f3a293b530020964a007f6bd6024682e); not yet flashed. T-alone mute is unchanged. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Do not treat 0.1.1-experimental as a pass. Same-unit card of 0.1.1 (ELEK TM 0.1.1, SHA-256 649a48d6c4125e32e41a6006476a4109df0ec8e246da6e8a720f9d609b5b357e): T1-T8 mute correctly, but FUNC+T does not focus — the edit track stays T1. 0.1.1 jmp'd stock 0x40083ab4 after clearing FUNC_HELD, which is too late and still does not change track while FUNC is part of the gesture. 0.1.2 writes the stock current-track bytes (0x80000035, 0x100b14cc) and jsr's the stock track-changed refresh on FUNC+T, including the type-3 tail. T-alone mute is unchanged.

Do not treat 0.1.0-experimental as a pass. Same-unit card of 0.1.0 (ELEK TM 0.1.0, SHA-256 3e35f72c5985a6d3cfbd9f7a64fdeec04ac5db05792c629d4a20480189779335): with TRACK MUTES showing X, T1-T8 still focused and FUNC+T still muted. 0.1.1 hooks jmp 0x40083ab4: with X, a T press toggles the stock mute word. Same-unit card of 0.1.1 (ELEK TM 0.1.1, SHA-256 649a48d6c4125e32e41a6006476a4109df0ec8e246da6e8a720f9d609b5b357e): T1-T8 mute, FUNC+T does not focus (stuck on T1). Not a pass; see 0.1.2-experimental.

First version: PERSONALIZE TRACK MUTES (empty/X, default empty). When ticked, T1-T8 mute and unmute; FUNC+T focuses the track for editing. Conflicts with Mute Modes and Play Start. Same-unit card of 0.1.0: X did not change stock T/FUNC+T. Not a pass; see 0.1.1-experimental.
